title: testing team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/testing.yaml, the team layer of the testing plugin's settings. The scan keys (adapters, paths, adapter_dirs, extend, rules) are resolved by plugins/testing/scripts/resolve-config.sh, whose loader holds their full grammar; the run-e2e keys by its e2e mode, and each wins over the plugin's userConfig value of the same name. Values use plain or single-quoted scalars: the scan loader refuses double quotes. Contract: docs/adr/0054-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

enable.description: Adapter ids; when any is listed, only listed adapters run.

disable.description: Adapter ids that do not run; wins over enable.

include.description: Globs relative to the repository root that are scanned even under a pruned directory.

exclude.description: Globs relative to the repository root that are not scanned; wins over include.

adapter_dirs.description: Directories of consumer adapter files, relative to the repository root or starting with ~/.

extend.description: Per adapter id, items appended to that adapter's list fields (files, test_start, assertion.calls and the rest the loader names).

rules.description: Rule levels: rule-<slug> (or testing/audit/rule-<slug>) and test-weaken-block, each off, warn or error.

e2e_driver.description: Who drives a /testing:run-e2e run. auto picks harness when a spec or script covers the changed flow, run for a CLI, TUI or service, and playwright for a browser; chrome is attended runs only.

reuse_running_instance.description: Whether /testing:run-e2e drives an app that already answers. auto and true reuse it, labelling unattended evidence; false stops with the gap report when an app already answers.

feature_map_dir.description: The directory /testing:map-features writes the feature map to and /testing:run-e2e reads it from, relative to the repository root. Refused: an absolute path, a value containing .., the root itself, or a segment starting with run- or ending in verify. Set here or in .claude/testing.local.yaml only; it has no userConfig option.
